name: The Count's Huntsman

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Count's Huntsman, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's revenant and wight: necrotic arrows and a hunting spear, scaled to CR 9 with a horn, legendary actions and Legendary Resistance. Drawn with the revenant's sprite.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Huntsman fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: The Rules of the Hunt
traits.summary: He must sound his horn three nights before a hunt, and a quarry who stands at the crossroads and beats him ends the hunt for good.
traits.text: The Huntsman sounds his horn on three nights before he runs a quarry down, and the hunt ends under the crossroads gallows at moonrise. A quarry who stands there and beats him in a fair fight ends the hunt for good: the count's own rule, made because he thought it could never be kept.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two attacks with Hunting Spear or Black Arrow in any mix.
actions.text: The Huntsman makes two attacks, using Hunting Spear or Black Arrow in any combination.

actions.name: Hunting Spear
actions.summary: A long boar spear, reach 10 ft, cold with the grave.
actions.text: Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Black Arrow
actions.summary: A black-fletched arrow that never misses its quarry's scent.
actions.text: Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horn of the Hunt
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: every creature within 60 ft that isn't Undead or a Beast makes a DC 16 Wis save or is Frightened until the end of his next turn.
actions.text: The Huntsman sounds his horn. Each creature within 60 feet of him that isn't an Undead or a Beast makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the Huntsman's next turn.

options.name: Into the Trees
options.summary: Moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

summary: The master of the count's hounds, four hundred years dead: a long grey man in a hunting coat gone black with weather, with a horn, a boar spear and a quiver of black arrows. He runs down whoever the count gives him, and every quarry he runs down becomes one of his hounds.
